title: Claude Code me slash command kaise banayein: sirf 1 file #shorts
description:
Claude Code me apna (custom) slash command kaise banayein? Sirf 1 file: SKILL.md. Phir /fix-issue 123 likho aur Claude aapke steps follow karega.

Steps (official Claude Code docs ke hisaab se):
1. Project me folder banaiye: .claude/skills/fix-issue/
2. Uske andar SKILL.md file rakhiye. Folder ka naam hi command banta hai: /fix-issue
3. File me sabse upar --- lines ke beech "description" likhiye (command kya karta hai), neeche aasaan steps.
4. Jahan $ARGUMENTS likha ho, wahan aapka type kiya hissa aata hai: /fix-issue 123 likhne par Claude ko milta hai "Fix GitHub issue 123 ...".

Dhyan rakhiye:
- Session pehle se chal raha tha aur skills folder naya bana? Ek baar /reload-skills chalaiye.
- Har project ke liye: home folder me ~/.claude/skills/ (sirf is project ke liye: .claude/skills/).
- Purani .claude/commands/ wali files bhi chalti hain; naye kaam ke liye docs skills folder sujhate hain.
